title: OPEC agrees to extend crude oil output cuts through Q3 2026
description: OPEC+ ministers agreed on Monday to maintain their current crude oil production cuts through the third quarter of 2026, supporting oil prices amid global demand uncertainty.
content: VIENNA, March 31 (Reuters) - OPEC+ ministers agreed on Monday to maintain their current crude oil production cuts through the third quarter of 2026, keeping the alliance's collective reduction at 3.66 million barrels per day. [+1250 chars]
